notes:
November 22nd 2026
Version 13.18.13 (stable) / 13.19.13 (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Manage UPA Files: a folder that does not answer no longer freezes the window. (R)
* R-Editor: copy and paste a whole hand or section between programs. (R)
* Score Editor: an 8va or chord name now only adds space on its own line. (K,R)
* Score Editor: choose the chord-name row; Ctrl+Up/Down moves an octave. (K,R)
* Score Editor: fixes for repeats, Fit on 2 pages and the Staff size slider. (K,R)
* Print (Mac): a PDF opened in Preview is no longer deleted when you quit. (K,R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
notes_beta:
November 23rd 2026
Version 13.18.14 (stable) / 13.19.14 (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Send to Hear: on the tree's right-click menu, with a Preview of the program you sent. (R)
* Live Editor (4X): Write/Save keeps the octave set on the panel or in the editor. (R)
* Live Editor: follows a program changed on the accordion and never saves over it. (R)
* Editors: a number box at its limit says so; Import Register explains its locked box. (K,R)
* Paste Special names the other file or backup the copy came from. (K,R)
* 8X/4X/EVO: a paste that changes nothing is greyed; Set Bank Prefix skips empty programs. (R)
* Score Editor: the toolbar fits on one row at 1200 px; Record warnings show in full. (K,R)
* Score Editor: Return goes to the start; clearer repeat hints; more accurate glissandos. (K,R)
* MIDI Monitor keeps drawing after Play; the DAW plugin keeps its settings in Cubase. (K,R)
* FISA: starts faster, and the tree keeps drawing during a drop. (K)
* Two Backups: clearer "renamed only" tooltip; typing in a tree no longer flips options. (K)
* Eject a USB memory stick from the drive list, or right after an install. (K,R)
* No more waits on a slow network folder or the 8X/4X/EVO menu after a Windows restart. (K,R)
* About's Close and tree header buttons show in full; libraries you don't own say "None". (K,R)
* Updates: the offer always shows its release notes; no "offline" message while online. (K,R)
* Better diagnostics for support. (K,R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
